If(gblLeftNavigationMenuIsExpanded,
"data:image/svg+xml;utf8, "&EncodeUrl("

"data:image/svg+xml;utf8, "&EncodeUrl("
<svg width='17' height='9' viewBox='0 0 19 9' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <path d='M0 9H17V0H0V9ZM16 8H13V1H16V8ZM12 8H1V1H12V8ZM7.14648 2.35352L8.79297 4H5V5H8.79297L7.14648 6.64648L7.85352 7.35352L10.707 4.5L7.85352 1.64648L7.14648 2.35352Z' fill='#595959'/>
</svg>
"))

If(
    And(
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project ID'),
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project Start Date'),
        Or(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity' = 0,
            IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity')
        ),
        Or(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50' = 0,
            IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50')
        ),
        Or(
            IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name),
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name = "Draft"
        )
    ),
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_33.Height * 7,
    IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project Start Date'),
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_33.Height * 6,
    Or(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity' = 0,
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity')
    ),
    // else / default height when none of the above conditions are true
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_33.Height * 5,
    Or(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50' = 0,
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50')
    ),
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_33.Height * 4,
    Or(
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name),
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name = "Draft"
    ),
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_33.Height * 3,
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_33.Height
)

Or(
    IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project ID'),// General not completed
    IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'End Date'),// Milestones not completed
    Or(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity' = 0,
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity')
    ),
    Or(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50' = 0,
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50')
    ),
    Or(
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name),
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name = "Draft"
    )
)

    IsBlank(ThisItem.'Contract Duration Years'),
    "",
    ThisItem.'Contract Duration Years' in [0, 1],
    ThisItem.'Contract Duration Years' & " year",
    ThisItem.'Contract Duration Years' & " years"
)

If(
    And(
        ThisItem.'Is Contract Duration Years Standard Assumption?' = 'Is Contract Duration Years Standard Assumption? (Project Revenues)'.Yes,
        ThisItem.'Is Contract Duration Months Standard Assumption?' = 'Is Contract Duration Months Standard Assumption? (Project Revenues)'.Yes
    ),
    ColorValue(gblAppTheme.palette.themePrimary)
)

If(
    And(
        ThisItem.'Is Contract Duration Years Standard Assumption?' = 'Is Contract Duration Years Standard Assumption? (Project Revenues)'.Yes,
        ThisItem.'Is Contract Duration Months Standard Assumption?' = 'Is Contract Duration Months Standard Assumption? (Project Revenues)'.Yes
    ),
    true,
    false
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    ThisItem.'Use Country Inflation Profile' = 'Use Country Inflation Profile (Project Revenues)'.Yes,
    If(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Italy",
        " Italy - " & Substitute(
            locAreaWithRegion,
            "Italy_",
            ""
        ),
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name
    ),
    Text(
        ThisItem.'Inflation Profile',
        "#0.00 "
    )
)
If(ThisItem.'Is Custom Inflation Profile Standard Assumption?' = 'Is Custom Inflation Profile Standard Assumption? (Project Revenues)'.Yes,ColorValue(gblAppTheme.palette.themePrimary))
If(ThisItem.'Is Custom Inflation Profile Standard Assumption?' = 'Is Custom Inflation Profile Standard Assumption? (Project Revenues)'.Yes,true,false)

    )}"

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Int(ThisItem.'Site Quality p90') = ThisItem.'Site Quality p90',
    Text(ThisItem.'Site Quality p90', "#"),
    Text(ThisItem.'Site Quality p90', "#0.0#")
)

And(
    gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
    ThisItem.Label = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
    gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology <> Technology.PV
)

$"Correction Factor {If(
        And(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
            gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = Technology.Wind,
            ThisItem.Label = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT
        ),
        "p50"
    )}"

Rules.InvariantScript: "Balancing prices can be managed when the project has reached Cluster 4"
"Use balancing costs only if a contract with the direct marketer exists for a given period. Otherwise and for other periods, global assumptions will be applied."

$"{ThisItem.'Contract Duration (Year)'} " & If(
    Or(
        ThisItem.'Contract Duration (Year)' = 1,
        ThisItem.'Contract Duration (Year)' = 0
    ),
    "Year",
    "Years"
) & " " & ThisItem.'Contract Duration (Month)' & " " & If(
    Or(
        ThisItem.'Contract Duration (Month)' = 1,
        ThisItem.'Contract Duration (Month)' = 0
    ),
    "Month",
    "Months"
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    And(
        Or(
            And(
                CountRows(colProjectBalancingPriceContracts) = 1,
                !IsBlank(locBalancingPriceSelectedContract)
            ),
            IsEmpty(colProjectBalancingPriceContracts)
        ),
        !IsBlank(locBalancingPriceSelectedContract)
    ),
    locBalancingPriceSelectedContract.'Shift of COD Date [Months]',
    "0"
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_BalancingPrice_ShiftOfCODDate.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_Revenues.IsInteger(txt_BalancingPrice_ShiftOfCODDate.Value))
    ),
    gblAppResx.Numeric,
    And(
        IsNumeric(txt_BalancingPrice_ShiftOfCODDate.Value),
        Not(
            And(
                Value(txt_BalancingPrice_ShiftOfCODDate.Value) > 0,
                Value(txt_BalancingPrice_ShiftOfCODDate.Value) < 24
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Value must be between 0 and 24."
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Or(
        And(
            CountRows(colProjectBalancingPriceContracts) = 1,
            !IsBlank(locBalancingPriceSelectedContract)
        ),
        IsEmpty(colProjectBalancingPriceContracts)
    ),
    DateAdd(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)',
        txt_BalancingPrice_ShiftOfCODDate.Value,
        TimeUnit.Months
    ),
    IsBlank(locBalancingPriceSelectedContract),
    DateAdd(
        Last(
            Sort(
                colProjectBalancingPriceContracts,
                'Created On',
                SortOrder.Ascending
            )
        ).'End Date Balancing Contract',
        1,
        TimeUnit.Days
    ),
    locBalancingPriceSelectedContract.'Start Date Balancing Contract'
)

If(
    And(
        locRevenueContractStartDate.Value = Self.SelectedDate,
        locRevenueContractStartDate.IsStandardAssumption
    ),
    true,
    false
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Int(locSelectedRevenueContract.'Site Quality p90') = locSelectedRevenueContract.'Site Quality p90',
    Text(locSelectedRevenueContract.'Site Quality p90', "#"),
    Text(locSelectedRevenueContract.'Site Quality p90', "#0.0#")
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_SiteQuality_p90.Value)),
        Not(fn_Common_Revenues.IsValidCurrency(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_SiteQuality_p90.Value))
    ),
    $"Numeric value with maximum of two decimals",
    And(
        IsNumeric(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_SiteQuality_p90.Value),
        Not(
            And(
                Value(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_SiteQuality_p90.Value) >= 0,
                Value(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_SiteQuality_p90.Value) <= 100
            )
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between 0 and 100."
)

$"Correction Factor {If(
    And(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
        drp_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Label_1.Selected.Value = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = Technology.Wind
    ),
    "p50"
)}"

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(locRevenueStandardValues.Correctionp50),
    "1.000",// return as text since we're formatting
    Text(
        locRevenueStandardValues.Correctionp50,
        "#0.000"
    )
)

If(
    And(
       locRevenueStandardValues.Correctionp50 = Value(Self.Value),
       locRevenueIsStandardAssumptions.IsCorrectionp50
    ),
    true,
    false
)

If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CorrectionFactor_1.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_Revenues.IsThreeDecimal(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CorrectionFactor_1.Value))
    ),
    gblAppResx.NumericThreeDecimals,
    And(
        IsNumeric(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CorrectionFactor_1.Value),
        Or(
            Value(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CorrectionFactor_1.Value) < 0.5,
            Value(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CorrectionFactor_1.Value) > 2
        )
    ),
    $"Please select a value between {If(StartsWith(Language(), "en"),"0.5","0,5")} and 2"
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(locSelectedRevenueSubaccount)),
        Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_TariffPrice_ErrorMessage_1.Visible),
        Not(IsBlank(drp_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Label_1.Selected)),
        Not(IsBlank(Trim(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Description_1.Value))),
        Not(IsBlank(drp_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Currency_1.Selected)),
        Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_TariffPrice_1.Text)),
        Not(IsBlank(dte_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ContractStartDate_1.SelectedDate)),
        Not(IsBlank(drp_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ContractDuration_Years_1.Selected)),
        Not(IsBlank(drp_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ContractDuration_Months_1.Selected)),
        Not(IsBlank(dte_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_ContractEndDate_1.SelectedDate)),
        Switch(
            locRevenueContractHedgeType.Value,
            'Hedging Type'.'Hedged Volume [%]',
            And(
                Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_HedgedVolume_1.Value)),
                Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_HedgedVolume_ErrorMessage_1.Visible)
            ),
            'Hedging Type'.'Fixed Volume p.a. [MWh]',
            And(
                Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_FixedVolume.Text)),
                Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_FixedVolume_ErrorMessage.Visible),
                Not(locRevenueContractHedgeFixedValue.InitialState)
            ),
            'Hedging Type'.'Individual Volumes',
            And(
                CountRows(colRevenueHedgeIndividualVolume) > 0,
                CountRows(
                    Filter(
                        colRevenueHedgeIndividualVolume,
                        Or(
                            IsBlank(VolumeValue),
                            InitialState = true
                        )
                    )
                ) = 0,
                CountRows(
                    Filter(
                        gal_ProjectRevenue_RightPanel_IndividualVolumeDetails.AllItems,
                        lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_IndividualVolume_ErrorMessage.Visible = true
                    )
                ) = 0
            )
        ),
        If(
            And(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
                drp_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Label_1.Selected.Value =/*'Revenue Labels'.'952850002'*/ 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology <> Technology.PV// Performed Changes Here
            ),
            And(
                Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_BiddingPrice_ErrorMessage_1.Visible),
                                                //Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_SiteQuality_ErrorMessage.Visible),
                Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CorrectionFactor_ErrorMessage_1.Visible),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_BiddingPrice_1.Value)),
                                                //Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_SiteQuality.Value)),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CorrectionFactor_1.Value)),
                Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_SiteQuality_ErrorMessage_1.Visible)
            ),
            true
        ),
        If(
            And(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
                drp_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Label_1.Selected.Value =/*'Revenue Labels'.'952850002'*/ 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology = Technology.Wind
            ),
            And(
                Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_SiteQuality_ErrorMessage_p90.Visible),
                Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CorrectionFactor_ErrorMessage_p90.Visible),
                Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_TariffPrice_ErrorMessage_p90.Visible),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_CorrectionFactor_p90.Value)),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_TariffPrice_1.Text))
            ),
            true
        ),
        Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_Description_ErrorMessage_1.Visible),
        If(
            tgl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Checked,
            And(
                Not(lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear_ErrorMessage_1.Visible),
                Not((lbl_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_ErrorMessage_1.Visible)),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationStartYear_1.Value)),
                Not(IsBlank(txt_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_InflationProfile_1.Value))
            ),
            true
        ),
        If(
            con_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_AreaInflationProfile_3.Visible,
            Not(IsBlank(drp_ProjectRevenues_RightPanel_NewEditCost_BodyContent_AreaInflationProfile_3.Selected)),
            true
        ),
        locRevenueContractFormDirty = true
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
With(
    {
        RevenueStartDate: DateValue(locRevenueContractStartDate.Value),
        RevenueEndDate: DateValue(locRevenueContractEndDate.Value),
        StartYear: Year(locRevenueContractStartDate.Value),
        EndYear: Year(locRevenueContractEndDate.Value),
        IsSingleYearContract: Year(locRevenueContractStartDate.Value) = Year(locRevenueContractEndDate.Value)
    },
    ClearCollect(
        colRevenueHedgeIndividualVolume,
        ForAll(
            Sequence(
                EndYear - StartYear + 1,
                StartYear,
                1
            ),
            {
                Year: Value,
                StartDate: If(
                    IsSingleYearContract,
                    RevenueStartDate,
                    Value = StartYear,
                    RevenueStartDate,
                    Date(
                        Value,
                        1,
                        1
                    )
                ),
                EndDate: If(
                    IsSingleYearContract,
                    RevenueEndDate,
                    Value = StartYear,
                    Date(
                        Value,
                        12,
                        31
                    ),
                    Value = EndYear,
                    RevenueEndDate,
                    Date(
                        Value,
                        12,
                        31
                    )
                ),
                IsStandardAssumption: false,
                VolumeValue: Value(Blank()),
                VolumeValueText: Text(Blank()),
                InitialState : true
            }
        )
    )
);
